correctness.rationale: PASS: Normalized Szego kernels give operator norm max boundary |f| and minimum modulus min boundary |f| and are weak-null at boundary. Every nonzero H2 function is nonzero a.e.; attainment of either extremum forces |f| constant on boundary, hence scalar finite Blaschke product by disk algebra inner-function argument. Boundary evaluation kernel is closed codim-one ideal and max NA-free complex linear subspace. At zero ζ, |f−g|(ζ)≥t while at max η distance≥|M−t| for norm-attaining g of constant modulus t; minimizing max≥M/2, equality f=(1−z)/2,g=1/2. Weak-null kernels prove approx/Gelfand/Kolmogorov widths; n boundary-localized nearly orthogonal kernels show Bernstein number M, all n≥1. H2 reflexive weak compactness forces quasi norm attainment equivalent to ordinary for this target. Quantifier all H2 dimensions and boundary points, no false full-operator algebra gap claim.
